items.title: Automated Penetration Testing Tool
items.body: An end-to-end framework for web and network testing covering information gathering, port scanning and SSL analysis. Attack-simulation modules reduce manual reconnaissance, and a reporting engine generates assessment reports automatically.

items.title: CVE Finder Pro
items.body: Identifies direct CVE IDs and transitive dependency risks in software packages. Version-tracking logic checks vulnerability databases and recommends secure upgrades, with automated Excel reports.

items.title: Image Steganography
items.body: An encryption and decryption application that hides data in PNG and JPEG files using least significant bit (LSB) encoding, keeping the embedded data visually undetectable.

items.title: Fotoholics: Image Cartoonizer with Emotion Prediction
items.body: A full-stack OpenCV application that converts photos into stylised cartoons using edge detection and colour quantisation, with a deep learning model for real-time emotion prediction.
